aiPage.definitionTitle: What an AI model is, in one sentence
aiPage.definition: An AI model is software that reads text and writes text. It is very good at drafting, summarising, classifying and retrieving information. It is not good at arithmetic, at deciding for you, or at guaranteeing it is not wrong. An "agent" is simply that software given permission to take a few precise actions — send a draft, create a record, fill in a document — within limits we set together.
aiPage.wontSellTitle: What I will not sell you
aiPage.dataIntro: The question I get most. Here is the full answer, without evasion.
aiPage.dataStaysText: Your files, your database and your backups go nowhere. The tool fetches an extract at the moment it needs one.
aiPage.dataEu: What goes to a European service
aiPage.dataEuText: The hosting of the tool itself, its technical logs and operational data: in Europe, wherever the feature allows.
aiPage.dataUs: What goes to a model provider
aiPage.dataUsText: The question asked and the document extracts needed to answer it. Nothing else. Your data is not used to train a model, and a processing agreement is signed.
aiPage.dataAlternativeText: Filter personal data before sending, send only the business context, or run a smaller model on your own hardware when the task allows it. We discuss this before writing code, not after.
aiPage.credibilityLine: In 2019, my first real project was precisely about filtering private data before it reached a cloud chatbot. The question of where your data goes is not one I am discovering today.
aiPage.honestyNote: One honest clarification: "hosted in Europe" is defensible, "your data never leaves the EU" is not, the moment a US model is called. Be wary of anyone promising you the second sentence.

privacy.intro: Short version: I collect only what I need to reply to you, I sell nothing, and I delete on request.
privacy.controllerText: Karim Khadro, {city}, Belgium — company number {bce}. You can reach me at {email}.
privacy.dataForm: Contact form: name, company, email, phone, budget, timing and your message. Legal basis: your consent. Purpose: replying to you and preparing a proposal.
privacy.dataBooking: Booking: if you load the calendar, Cal.com processes the information needed for the booking, under its own policy.
privacy.dataDemos: AI demos: your message is sent to Anthropic to produce the reply. Message content is not stored; only token counts and status codes are recorded.
privacy.dataAnalytics: Analytics: cookieless audience measurement with no personal identifier, via Vercel Analytics.
privacy.retentionText: Enquiries received through the form are kept for 24 months in my mailbox, then deleted.
privacy.processorsText: Vercel (hosting, Frankfurt region), Resend (email delivery), Cal.com (bookings, only if you load the calendar), Cloudflare (bot protection), Upstash (rate limiting), Anthropic (AI demos only). No data is ever sold.
privacy.cookiesText: This site sets no advertising or analytics cookies. Only two technical cookies exist: your language choice, and a session cookie for the demos. That is why there is no consent banner to click through.
privacy.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. Write to {email} and I handle the request within 30 days. You may also lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (autoriteprotectiondonnees.be).
